protocol.gemini_billing_confirmation: User confirmed billing working for this round
protocol.anchor_rules: span/step, observed tool_name, fictional-world names present in supporting text, observed IDs, exact prose outputs 12-160 chars or numeric outputs 3-40 chars; no gold answers
protocol.normalization: NFKC, JSON key canonicalization when applicable, casefold, whitespace collapse; preserve values and IDs

embedding.pooling: L2 normalized token-count-weighted mean of nonoverlapping max_seq_length-2 token chunk embeddings
embedding.near_distinct: connected components of within-class pairs with cosine >=0.9 (transitive); direct pairs also recorded

protocol.examples: first three selection records per class per arm, without choosing by outcome
protocol.concurrency: one sequential stream per arm; arms concurrent; aggregate reservation writes locked
protocol.qwen_stall_policy: 45-second request timeout; stop Qwen arm on first transport stall; no fabricated denominator
